# Integration

Integration is a t-shirt design storefront built on the theme "Different Styles, One Identity" — Japanese streetwear aesthetics brought together in a single curated catalog. Customers can browse products, view detailed pages, add items to a cart, and check out. Orders are processed manually: bKash, Nagad, Rocket, and Cash on Delivery are accepted; the team confirms payment out-of-band. Customer accounts, order history, and an admin panel (order + product management) are included.

## All pages

- [Home](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/): Hero carousel with seasonal banners, featured products row, category grid, newsletter signup.
- [Shop](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/shop): Full product catalog. Search box, category filters, sorting, and pagination. Filterable by tag via query parameter, e.g. `?tag=streetwear`.
- [Product detail](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/product): Per-product page with image gallery, size selection, quantity, and add-to-cart. Loaded dynamically per product (no public list; products appear in Shop).
- [Cart](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/cart): Line items, quantity updates, total in BDT, clear-cart confirmation.
- [Checkout](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/checkout): Requires login. Shipping/address form, payment method selection (bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Cash on Delivery), order summary.
- [Order confirmation](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/orders): Requires login. Order history with status; each order opens a detail page with post-checkout summary and next steps for the selected payment method.
- [My Orders](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/orders): Requires login. Order history with status.
- [Log in](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/login): Account sign in (email + password).
- [Sign up](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/signup): Account creation.
- [Forgot password](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/forgot-password): Password reset request.
- [Reset password](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/reset-password): Password reset via emailed link.
- [Verify email](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/verify-email): Email verification handling.

## Admin

- [Admin orders](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/admin/orders): Admin-only. Manage order status and view payment method badges.
- [Admin products](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/admin/products): Admin-only. Create/edit products and images.

## Company

- [About](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/about): Brand storytelling — the story behind Integration and the "one identity" philosophy.
- [Contact](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/contact): Contact channels and business details.
- [FAQ](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/faq): Frequently asked questions including ordering and payments.

## Technical summary

- Frontend: React 19 + Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand (cart), TanStack Query, Framer Motion.
- Backend: Express + Mongoose, Zod validation, Brevo transactional email, pdfkit order receipts.
- Deployment: Single repository; client built and served statically by the Express server; assets served gzip-compressed and cached. Hosted at `https://integration-06n2.onrender.com`.
